content.title: Two Abhyasis race for the last sitting place
content.intent: Two eligible Abhyasis attempt to book the same remaining place concurrently; the total bookings never exceed capacity.
content.technique_notes: Concurrency, state_flow, idempotency-risk assessment: same slot contention, not speculative retry semantics. EQP: capacity 1/default versus capacity greater than 1; numeric default is not a stated boundary so BVA is inapplicable. auth/data-loss risk requests strength=3; covering_array produced all eight link × visibility × occupancy triples, but the four-pair ceiling prioritizes distinct outcomes rather than eight redundant executions. No API endpoint or synchronization mechanism is specified.
